custom_logic_notes: EA places Buy Stop pending order above Ask+SL*Point when DeMarker crosses above OverBought level, and Sell Stop pending order below Bid-SL*Point when DeMarker crosses below OverSold level. Pending orders are placed on new bar detection. Existing pending orders are deleted before placing new ones if no position is open. Digit adjustment applied: SL/TP values multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001. DeMarker uses previous bar [1] vs current bar [0] for crossover/crossunder detection. Magic number assigned to all orders for identification.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas_ta or ta-lib DeMarker indicator. Digit adjustment logic translates to: if price_decimals >= 5, multiply SL/TP pip values by 10 before converting to price units. Pending order placement requires simulating buy-stop above current price and sell-stop below. New bar detection via timestamp comparison. Position check via tracking open trades by magic number. No external MQH dependencies to port.
